transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call this batch-disposition huddle to order for Batch H-418. As we all know, a cure-temperature alarm appeared during the Tuesday night run on Press 8, though the electronic production record shows the programmed temperature was within specification. Before I make any disposition decision on the 1,000 molded housings currently staged on pallets P1 through P4, I need two things: the laboratory report and a pallet-level traceability check. Can I get those in front of me now?

I completed a differential-scanning-calorimetry review of retained samples after the alarm, and it confirmed that exactly 240 housings from Batch H-418 are undercured. I'm still finalizing the upload to the quality system, but the findings are here for the huddle now.

decisions.disposition: Split disposition: P2 and P3 placed on hold for thermal rework and hardness testing; P1 and P4 cleared for release.
decisions.shipment_release_plan: P1 and P4 (760 unaffected housings) may proceed to shipment immediately. P2 and P3 (240 undercured housings) must complete the 4-hour thermal rework, followed by hardness testing on all 240 reworked units. Upon successful hardness test results, P2 and P3 may then be released for shipment.
